difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the product with a fixed sheaf is left adjoint to the sheaf of morphisms from that sheaf, giving a canonical bijection of morphism sets functorial in all three entries (statement lines 5933-5945). The proof is a complete construction: the unit is defined by pairing a section with the identity (proof lines 5952-5966); the counit is the evaluation map, written out on sections (proof lines 5967-5982); and the two passages between maps out of the product and maps into the internal hom are written explicitly on sections (proof lines 5983-6000), the author recording that the verification that they are mutually inverse is omitted (proof lines 6001-6002). The non-formal content is the two explicit constructions. The claim is H2: a construction with the two directions written out.
